title: Design System: ShopDeck Predictive RTO System

display.purpose: Page titles and hero metrics. Reserved for ≤1 per page.

headline.purpose: Section titles and subsection headings. Establishes clear information hierarchy.

body.purpose: Descriptive text, data rows, explanatory copy. Default everywhere. Max line length 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, button text, captions, risk scores. Subtle tracking reinforces precision.

shadows.name: hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Applied to buttons, cards, inputs on hover. Cyan glow signals responsiveness without overwhelming.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on all interactive elements. Blue ring ensures WCAG AA keyboard navigation support.

motion.name: transition-interactive
motion.purpose: State changes (hover, focus, toggle). Snappy, responsive, no easing overshoot.

motion.name: transition-color
motion.purpose: Text and color-only changes. Decoupled from layout transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast, full-strength accent. Used for primary CTAs (Apply Intervention, Save Rules).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #06b6d4; color: #000; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3b82f6; color: #f1f5f9; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.15); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower visual weight. Used for supporting actions (Cancel, Dismiss).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #334155; color: #f1f5f9; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1e293b; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Dark tertiary background, light text. Blue outline on focus. No border at rest.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #334155; color: #f1f5f9; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: none; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: all 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 2px; background: #475569; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Risk Score Badge
components.description: Three-signal risk display: color circle + icon + numeric score. High risk (red) example shown.
components.css: .ds-risk-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-risk-circle { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-risk-badge--high .ds-risk-circle { background: #ef4444; } .ds-risk-badge--high .ds-risk-score { color: #ef4444; } .ds-risk-badge--medium .ds-risk-circle { background: #f59e0b; } .ds-risk-badge--medium .ds-risk-score { color: #f59e0b; } .ds-risk-badge--low .ds-risk-circle { background: #10b981; } .ds-risk-badge--low .ds-risk-score { color: #10b981; } .ds-risk-score { color: #f1f5f9; }

narrative.overview: This system is a dark, technical command center for D2C sellers managing their return risk. The interface prioritizes data clarity and decisive action over decoration. Confidence comes from precision: every element earns its place, every color has a job, every interaction is instant and responsive. The dark theme signals expertise and authority. The cyan-blue palette carries electric energy—modern, tech-forward, and commanding. Sellers open this tool knowing their margins are at stake and trusting that ShopDeck's data and recommendations are bulletproof.
keyCharacteristics: Data is the hero; UI is transparent and minimal
Interactions are snappy and responsive, not decorative
Risk levels use color + icon + number (never color alone)
High contrast throughout for expert precision and accessibility

rules.name: The Electric Energy Rule
rules.body: Cyan and blue together signal that this tool is modern and serious. They are never diluted with transparency or used as background tints; they appear as full-strength accents on buttons, links, and focus states. Their rarity (≤10% of the screen) is the point.

rules.name: The Three-Signal Rule
rules.body: Risk levels are always communicated by color + icon + numeric score. Color alone is insufficient. A user with color blindness must instantly understand the risk by reading the number and identifying the icon.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Body text on dark backgrounds must hit 4.5:1 contrast (WCAG AA minimum). Light Slate achieves 8.5:1 against Deep Navy, providing margin for smaller type and placeholder text.

rules.name: The No-Personality Rule
rules.body: The type is system default throughout. No custom fonts, no serif, no script. Sellers don't come for typography; they come for margin recovery data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No persistent shadows. Cards and surfaces have no drop shadows at rest. Shadows only on hover or focus. This discipline keeps the interface precise and data-focused. Depth is implied by position and color, not by shadow.

dos: Do use cyan for primary CTAs (Apply Intervention, Save). High contrast, commanding presence.
Do pair color + icon + number for risk levels. Never rely on color alone for status communication.
Do use label-weight (500) for all form labels, button text, and risk scores. Subtle tracking signals precision.
Do keep card shadows flat at rest and apply cyan glow only on hover.
Do use light slate (#f1f5f9) for all body text and ensure ≥4.5:1 contrast.
Do stack buttons vertically if space is tight; never wrap buttons in one row.
Do test every interactive element for keyboard focus (blue outline ring).
donts: Don't use generic SaaS dashboard patterns: heavy cards with drop shadows, rounded-corner decoration, pastel backgrounds.
Don't use emoji, playful copy, or warm tones. Sellers are stressed about returns; the tool should feel serious and expert.
Don't use border-left stripes or gradient text. Clarity over decoration.
Don't apply shadows to surfaces at rest. Shadows only on hover/focus.
Don't mix fonts or use custom web fonts. System sans-serif throughout.
Don't use purple as a primary accent; reserve it for rare emphasis or special states.
Don't rely on color alone for status. Always pair with icon and numeric value.
Don't set opacity on text to indicate lower importance. Use a darker gray or different size instead.
Don't add animations for their own sake. Motion is rare and responsive (button press, filter change, focus).
